items.t: Broadcom Stock Plunges 12% and Loses $191 Billion After a Report That Google Cut Its Plans for Broadcom AI Chips
items.sum: Broadcom fell 12% Friday afternoon after analyst Ming-Chi Kuo said Google cut about 1 million Broadcom-designed AI chips from its 2027 plans. The stock is headed for its worst day since June and sits 36% below its record. Earnings are Dec. 9.

items.t: Broadcom is Overvalued at 17.73X P/E: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.sum: AVGO's 17.73X P/E signals overvaluation, but surging AI semiconductor revenues and strong hyperscaler ties support long-term growth. Is holding the stock wise?

items.t: Broadcom Stock Falls on Report Google is Cutting AI Chip Shipments
items.sum: The chip maker’s stock fell more than 10% Friday in what’s proving to be a rough week for it and its competitors.

items.t: Goldman Sachs Cut Its Broadcom Target to $460, and the Reason Has Nothing to Do With Broadcom’s Earnings
items.sum: Key Takeaways Goldman Sachs cut its Broadcom price target to $460 from $540 on Nov. 18 and kept its Buy rating, so the target was still 30% above that day’s close.

items.t: Broadcom Stocks Move Lower as Anthropic IPO Eases Its $42 Billion Lending Risk
items.sum: Broadcom is Anthropic's supplier, lender and now shareholder, after buying $1 billion of shares in the IPO placement.

items.t: Google reportedly cuts Broadcom-designed TPU plans, eyes more MediaTek chips
items.sum: Investing.com -- Google has reduced its planned 2027 shipments of Broadcom-designed AI chips while preparing to increase shipments of a MediaTek-designed alternative, according to technology supply-chain analyst Ming-Chi Kuo.
